description: Unverified observations from OCD Check reports of people's phones (observed/reports/, every account but the owner's), per device, carrier profile, software stack and entry. A report only points at an entry of OCD's data at one commit or release; it never changes an OCD value, a file under generated/ or a release, and it never makes a phone skip its own test. Nothing here is a support claim. The owner's results are in observed/retested.json.

statuses.reported: Counted reports of people's phones, by result. Not checked by OCD: anyone can open an issue, and nothing checks who sent a report or whether the phone exists.
statuses.contested: At least one counted report measured a clean failure of the entry (the test ran and the phone's state came back). It asks the next phone to test the entry and a maintainer to look; it switches nothing off.
statuses.retested_by_ocd: Always null here. The owner's phones' settled results are published as "re-tested by OCD" in observed/retested.json (rule round 29), a separate file.
